name: Ijiwaru Onee-san no Otsumami! 2 ~Senpai no Otouto ni Chokkai Dashitara Kairaku Sekai o Shikomare Chatta~
original_name: 意地悪お姉さんの牡つまみ！2 ～先輩の弟にちょっかい出したら快楽 世界をシコまれちゃった～
source:
Rumi Hirose witnesses her senior colleague at work, Eri Uemura—who got married a few months ago—entering a love hotel arm-in-arm with a man other than her husband.

Although the man looked vaguely familiar, she couldn’t quite place him… but since he was clearly not the groom she’d seen at the wedding, she was convinced it was an affair.

Unable to confront Eri directly, she spent her days feeling restless and unsettled—
Then, by chance, she ran into Shinji on the street.

Since they’d *** before, Rumi used the affair as leverage to blackmail Shinji, luring him into her room and forcing herself on him.
The next morning, after the *** had worn off, she panicked and sent Shinji away… but the video she’d recorded on her phone clearly showed her making a pass at him.

Though she blamed herself for what she’d done, her sexual curiosity was piqued by the sound of her own voice, lost in pleasure.
Before she knew it, she found herself looking for Shinji, and the two met again.
Just one more time… I want to really feel it.

Driven by that desire, she invited Shinji to a hotel, and faced with his unimaginable stamina, Rumi found her body and soul completely consumed by him, falling deeply in love.

Shinji, a masochistic man with boundless stamina who had already been *** by Eri.
Rumi, a rough-and-tumble girl with zero feminine charm.
Where will their love story lead…?

那个男人看着似乎有些眼熟，留美却一时想不起究竟在哪见过……但既然明显不是婚礼上见过的那位新郎，她断定这毫无疑问是一场婚外情。

没法直接找爱理当面质问的留美，接连好几天都心神不宁、坐立难安——
就在这时，她在街上偶然撞见了信二。

由于两人之前曾***过，留美便拿这桩出轨丑闻当作把柄要挟信二，将他诱进自己的房间强行推倒。
第二天早上，等***劲头消退之后，惊慌失措的留美连忙把信二打发走了……可手机里录下的视频却清清楚楚地拍下了她主动索欢的模样。

尽管她对自己的所作所为懊悔自责，但录像里自己沉溺快感时的娇喘声，却勾起了她蠢蠢欲动的性好奇心。
不知不觉间，她又主动四处寻找起信二的身影，两人很快再度相会。
就再做一次……好想再好好感受一回那种快感。

在这股欲望的驱使下，留美主动约信二去了旅馆；面对信二超乎想象的绝伦精力，留美从肉体到灵魂都被他彻底征服，深深坠入了情网。

早已被爱理***过、精力无穷无尽的抖M男信二；
大大咧咧、毫无半点女人味的粗线条女子留美。
两人的恋情究竟将走向何方……？
